propositions: MCP v1 FastMCP defines generic Settings before FastMCP class exists while postponed annotations are enabled, leaving Settings.lifespan as an unresolved ForwardRef
On first FastMCP construction, pydantic-settings 2.15 detects incomplete FieldInfo and emits IncompleteFieldDefinitionWarning, causing build_server() to abort when the warning is promoted to error
Calling public Settings.model_rebuild() after MCP import resolves the forward reference and eliminates the warning before first construction
The fix must invoke Settings.model_rebuild() at the lazy MCP import boundary in build_server() without suppressing the warning, pinning dependencies, or migrating to MCP v2
Fresh-process test contract requires a subprocess facade because first construction mutates global pydantic model state and subsequent constructions in the same process do not reproduce the warning
